sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 2424 (14 of 17 campsites listed)

values.note: Reservation required May 1-Sep 30, online only through ReserveAmerica / NY State Parks ('they will not take the initial reservation over the phone'); DEC says reservations open April 1, ReserveAmerica shows a 180-day window. No cancellations. First-come, first-served Oct 1-Apr 30, when a Forest Ranger permit is needed for 4+ nights. 14 nights per calendar year on any one site or combination of sites.

booking.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/stoney-pond-state-forest ('Camping reservations for Stoney Pond must be made through the New York State Parks or Reserve America web pages'; 'Reservations can be made beginning April 1'; 'The maximum length of stay on ANY one site or a combination of sites is 14 nights per calendar year'; Oct 1-Apr 30 'first-come first-served basis; there are no reservations') + https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=2424 ('can be made up to 180 Day(s) in advance'; 'Cancellations are not permitted'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/stoney-pond-state-forest (designated sites by reservation May 1-Sep 30, 'Campsites are available on a first-come first-served basis' Oct 1-Apr 30), read 2026-10-21

summary: DEC page and ReserveAmerica confirm free designated sites, online-only reservation May 1-Sep 30 (FCFS Oct-Apr), 14 nights a year, no hookups; ReserveAmerica's list today shows sites 012, 013, 015 at 30 ft (010 and 014, accessible, not in the list); access is town roads from Nelson (Eireville Rd, Old State Rd, Jones Rd), with no 4WD or clearance warning.
